tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App and page background behind cards and panels. Product screens use canvas; long reading pages may stay on surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, buttons and inputs: the raised layer that sits on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Sidebars, code wells, quiet wells inside a panel.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: The track behind segmented Tabs, status pills, hover fills. Never used for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface. Also the fill of a selected chip.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, helper text, unselected tabs. Passes 4.5:1 on surface-0, canvas, -100 and -200.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (selected chip).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only. Too faint for a control edge — use border-strong there.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges of buttons, chips, cards and panels, always paired with a fill or shadow change. Inputs and anything that must be found by its edge use border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs and other controls that must be seen (3:1 or better on surface-0).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, links, the focus ring, selected tabs. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled with brand.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brand fill: highlighted rows, the info banner, a pinned board header.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Deep navy for runbook pins, the cover and small callouts. Page headers stay white. Lifts to a mid-navy in Dark so it still reads against surface-0. Text on it is on-deep.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on deep.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: State only: passed checks, merged, healthy.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: State only: deprecated, needs attention. Text-safe on surface-0.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: State only: errors and destructive actions.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fill of a success status pill (Accepted, Chosen, Passed). Text on it is success: 4.66:1 in Light, 6.79:1 in Dark. Never a page or card background.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fill of a warning status pill (Open question, Needs attention). Text on it is warning: 4.91:1 in Light, 7.49:1 in Dark. Never a page or card background.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on deep: hero captions, stat-tile notes inside a hero band. Passes 4.5:1 on deep in both themes.

tokens.name: viz-empty
tokens.usage: Data viz: a cell with no value (not run, not measured, zero). Never used for text.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Data viz sequential step 1 of 5 (lowest). Steps differ in lightness, so the ramp reads in grayscale and for color-blind readers.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Data viz step 2 of 5. Also the 'before' series in a before/after comparison.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Data viz step 3 of 5.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Data viz step 4 of 5; equals brand. Also the 'new' or 'after' series.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Data viz step 5 of 5 (highest). In Dark it is the lightest step, so 'most' stays 'most contrast with the ground'.

tokens.name: viz-highlight
tokens.usage: Data viz attention mark: the one thing to look at (an outlier, a survivor, a regression). Never a series color, never text on surface-0.

tokens.name: grad-brand
tokens.usage: Section-mark tiles and big stat figures (as text fill). White icons on it. Never behind body text.

tokens.name: grad-wash
tokens.usage: The one band a page most wants read (dp-band--wash), the 'after' card, the 'cut' steps. Cards on it stay surface-0.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Corner glow on alternate bands (dp-band--alt), as a radial gradient on canvas.

tokens.name: glow-warm
tokens.usage: The opposite corner's glow on alternate bands. Barely there; the amber is a hint, not a colour.

families.display: Geist, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.ui: Geist, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Portal hero headline. One per page.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pin the snippets, docs and runbooks your team keeps re-finding.

styles.name: pin-title
styles.usage: Pin card title, two lines max, then truncate.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a pin; always ink-muted.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code inside body text, on surface-100.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a pin's media and its title; stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal button padding (sm), chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Masonry column gap and card padding; the default step.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status pills, actor tags, count badges, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Everything you press or type in: buttons, chips, tabs, search and text fields, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, pins, list items, step boxes, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and board columns that hold cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, modals, hero media.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and status dots only. Never a button, chip, tab or badge.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Cards, secondary buttons, the selected segmented tab: a short, soft lift off canvas, slightly downward like paper on a desk.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card that holds a figure or a finding on a plain ground (stat tile, before/after card, featured pin). Use on the one or two cards that matter in a section, not on every card.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: menus, popovers, toasts, the save bar.
